description: This file defines a set of functions and callbacks for generating indented JSON structures within a CMake build system. It includes functions for beginning and ending JSON objects and arrays, handling key-value pairs, and serializing literals with proper indentation. The code sets up a callback table for JSON serialization and provides a main function to invoke the process with a given context.

methods.name: json_indented
methods.description: Main function that initializes a new map, sets up callbacks, and executes the JSON serialization process with a given context.
